source:
@@U04706@@
(From inside him.)

@@U04707@@
The sight is great,
but earth’s too gloomy,
it moves us with dread,
we tremble in fear.
Good father,
let us free from here.

@@U04709@@
Mount, rise up, to higher circles,
grow invisibly as God’s
presence makes you ever stronger
with eternal purity.
This it is that feeds the spirit,
this that fills ethereal space,
love’s eternal revelation,
love that leads to pure salvation.

@@U04711@@
(Circling around the highest peaks.)

@@U04712@@
Join hands and sing!
Join hands in a ring!
Dance and sing your deepest feelings!
Divinely schooled,
be certain to see,
Him that you love in eternity!

@@U04714@@
(Hovering in the upper atmosphere, bearing 浮士德’ immortal part.)

@@U04715@@
Saved now, saved from Satan’s power,
this great soul rejoices.
Who strives, and never ceases striving,
is worthy of redemption.
And if the love that reigns on high
has shown him gracious favor,
then angel hosts will sing his praise,
and give him joyous welcome.
translation:
@@U04706@@
（来自他的内心。）

@@U04707@@
景色很棒，
但地球太阴暗，
它让我们感到恐惧，
我们因恐惧而颤抖。
好父亲，
让我们离开这里吧。

@@U04709@@
登上，上升，到更高的圈子，
无形地成长为上帝的
存在让你变得更加强大
具有永恒的纯洁性。
正是这个滋养了精神，
这充满了空灵的空间，
爱的永恒启示，
爱带来纯粹的救赎。

@@U04711@@
（绕着最高峰转一圈。）

@@U04712@@
携起手来，歌唱吧！
手牵着手，围成一圈！
跳舞、唱出你最深的感受！
受过神学，
一定要看到，
你永远爱的他！

@@U04714@@
（悬浮在高层大气，承载着浮士德的不朽部分。）

@@U04715@@
现在得救了，脱离了撒但的权势，
这个伟大的灵魂很高兴。
努力奋斗，永不停息的人，
是值得救赎的。
如果爱在高处统治
已向他施恩，
然后天使们将歌颂他，
并热烈欢迎他。
